messages:
Asha (PM): Quick design check — placing the in-product docs sidecar on the right causes truncation in RTL locales. Marta noticed glossary links don't align. Thoughts? :thinking:
Liam (Designer): I saw that in the RTL QA pass. The sidecar width calc uses LTR padding. I can push a fix to swap margins + update the small-screen breakpoint.
Diego (Frontend): Can you paste repro steps? I can't repro in Chrome with v1.4.3.
Marta (Docs): Repro steps: 1) set account locale to 'ar' 2) open console > Models > Model Details 3) click the '?' docs icon -> sidecar opens but header text overflows and anchor links map to wrong id. Screenshot: https://redwood.test/snap123.png
Asha (PM): The bigger issue is terminology: in the panel we say 'Quick docs' but docs site uses 'Guides & Glossary'. Users get confused when follow links. We should harmonize to 'Docs' or 'Guides' across both.
Liam (Designer): Agree. Prefer 'Guides' for discoverability. Also propose changing CTA from 'Open docs' to 'Open guide' and use a breadcrumb 'Console > Guides > Model details' in the panel header.
Diego (Frontend): Will need backward-compatible anchor URLs. Right now console links to /docs#kv-cache but docs renamed anchors to /guides#kv-cache-v2. I can add redirect mapping in the router.
Marta (Docs): I can add alias anchors server-side: add <a id='kv-cache' /> to point to the new 'kv-cache-v2' heading. Also I'll update the cross-link copy to 'See guide: KV cache' so match labels.
Asha (PM): Accessibility nit: screen reader reads 'Open docs button' but doesn't announce the context. Should include aria-label='Open Guides for Model: <model_name>'. Also keyboard focus trap when sidecar opens — Liam?
Liam (Designer): I'll add focus management and update the panel role to dialog with aria-modal. Also ensure close button is first focusable item.
Diego (Frontend): Quick snippet for aria label I'm going to use:
```html
<button aria-label="Open Guides for Model: {{modelName}}">?</button>
```
aria-bot: Accessibility scan: sidecar dialog has contrast 3.8:1 on header text. Minimum AA needs 4.5:1 for small text. Flagging as 'needs-fix'.
Marta (Docs): One more ask — when we surface inline glossary terms in doc panels, can we link to a compact glossary modal instead of external page? Saves context switching.
Asha (PM): Good idea. Let's scope: Liam to deliver UI mock for RTL + focus changes by EOD Wednesday; Diego to implement anchor redirects + aria label this sprint; Marta to add anchors + adjust copy. I'll own product alignment and rollout note for support docs. :white_check_mark:
Liam (Designer): I'll drop mocks in #design after lunch. :+1:
Diego (Frontend): I'll open a PR w/ tests and add e2e for RTL panel order. Linking issue: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/2345
Marta (Docs): I'll add short changelog entry and update cross-link map. Ping me for wording reviews. :eyes:
Asha (PM): Thanks team. We'll follow up in tomorrow standup. Thread closed unless blockers.
